purpose: Acquire the same authoritative 2026-07-20..22 BRTI discovery period in bounded hourly responses after the sealed DAY acquisition returned an upstream 503 without exposing or persisting any experiment value.

pre_v2_information.adaptation_reason: The passthrough returned 503 after approximately five seconds for the first DAY payload. HOUR is an officially supported RTI timespan and bounds response size; no model outcome or BRTI value was observed before this adaptation.

download.hour_start_rule: Every integral UTC hour from first_hour_start_utc through last_hour_start_utc inclusive.
download.storage: Deterministic gzip of each successful raw Kalshi hourly envelope, mtime=0. The acquisition receipt records every attempt's HTTP status, elapsed time, body bytes/hash, and validation class, but no individual BRTI value.

hard_guards: Never issue a history request whose timestamp is 2026-07-23 or later.
Every hour must contain exactly the 3600 unique millisecond timestamps hour_start+k*1000 for k=0..3599; any missing, duplicate, off-grid, or out-of-hour timestamp fails the full acquisition.
Only a first-attempt HTTP 429 or 503 may receive one retry, after the fixed 3000ms backoff and the shared global attempt-start limiter.
No redirect, network-error retry, proxy substitution, interpolation, later-period fill, or partial analysis is permitted.
Never call recent /cfbenchmarks/values as a substitute.
Never print or persist credentials, signatures, auth timestamps, private-key paths, or individual BRTI values in console/receipt.
If any of the 72 logical hours fails, calibration is NO_DECISION and the model analyzer must not run.

calibration_contract.sigma60: Non-demeaned timestamp-aware diffusion over strict trailing 60s.
calibration_contract.sigma300: Non-demeaned timestamp-aware diffusion over strict trailing 300s.
calibration_contract.settlement_crosscheck: Require exactly 60 authoritative one-second BRTI values in [close-60s,close), compute their mean, and require (mean>=floor_strike) to equal official result.

deployment: No acquisition or calibration result authorizes trading, engine mutation, or parameter change.
